title: ananas arvensis
intro: Ananas arvensis, commonly known as wild pineapple or wild pineapple plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Bromeliaceae. The plant is known for its edible fruit, which is rich in antioxidants, vitamins, and minerals, providing several health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, as well as being used to treat digestive issues and skin problems. The therapeutic actions of Ananas arvensis include its ability to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and exhibit antiviral properties, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Ananas arvensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic properties and potential health benefits.
